method: Page-image inspection, not OCR. Word pages rendered through LibreOffice by render_docx.py; delivered PDFs typeset separately through XeLaTeX from the canonical Markdown.

pdf.noted_pages: Cover and contents; methods contribution list and Lemma 1; all equations, tables and figures; final changed pages 1, 38, 39, 54 and 57 rechecked.

repairs: Plus and asterisk subscripts misrendered in the inspection renderer. Replaced only those labels by p_pos and H_AIU and re-rendered; corrected pages checked visually. Delimiters, inline conjunction, probability exponents and table equations are visible.
limitations: No Microsoft Word application test, formal mathematical semantic-equivalence proof, PDF/A validator or PDF/UA certification. All-page visual review cannot certify scientific truth.
